description: Defines the HpackDecoderStringBuffer class used for managing string buffers in HPACK decoding within HTTP/2, including Huffman decoding support and buffer management.

classes.name: HpackDecoderStringBuffer
classes.description: Manages string buffers for HPACK decoding, supporting Huffman decoding, buffer management, and state tracking.

methods.description: Sets the buffer with a string view and static flag.
